name: agent-suggest
description: Advisory, dismissible prompt-time hint suggesting the cost-suited agent (Claude Code vs OpenCode). Monitoring-only product line: no flagging, no enforcement, nothing stored or sent.

commands.title: Agent Suggest: Show my prompts (this session)

agentSuggest.enabled.description: Show the advisory model suggestion at prompt time. Per the PRD this is the only workflow-touching feature; it is always dismissible and a non-matching choice is never recorded.

agentSuggest.minConfidence.description: Suppress the hint below this classification confidence (the §4.6 accuracy caveat: prompt-time classification is weaker than post-hoc).
